variables.CODE_CONVENTIONS:
### Go (services/)
- Arquitetura hexagonal ESTRITA: `domain/` tem ZERO dependencias externas
- Ports sao interfaces em `internal/ports/`, adapters implementam em `internal/adapters/`
- Logica de negocio vive em `internal/application/` — NUNCA em adapters ou handlers
- Lambda handlers finos: parse request -> chama service -> formata response
- Testes table-driven; cobertura 80%+ em domain e application
- Error handling: `fmt.Errorf("operacao: %w", err)`
- Naming: camelCase (unexported), PascalCase (exported)
- Lint: `golangci-lint run ./...`
- Test: `go test ./... -v`

### C# / Blazor (src/)
- Componentes seguem SRP: um concern por arquivo .razor
- Usar RenderFragment composition, evitar proliferacao de parametros boolean
- Services injetados via DI; nunca instanciar HttpClient diretamente
- Format: `dotnet format`
- Build: `dotnet build`
- Test: `dotnet test`

### General
- NUNCA commitar secrets, .env ou API keys
- Todos os endpoints validam input
- Commits: prefixos "add", "fix", "update", "refactor"
- Toda feature nova precisa de pelo menos um teste unitario

variables.FORMAT_HOOK: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.go) cd {{PROJECT_PATH}}/services && gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null ;; *.cs|*.razor) cd {{PROJECT_PATH}}/src && dotnet format --include "$FILE" --verbosity quiet 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0
variables.BUILD_CHECK_HOOK: cd {{PROJECT_PATH}} && echo '=== Build Check ===' && (cd services && go build ./cmd/... 2>&1 | tail -5 || true) && (cd src && dotnet build --verbosity quiet 2>&1 | tail -5 || true)
variables.ARCH_REVIEW_RULES:
- Go: Does it follow hexagonal architecture? Domain must not import adapters.
   - Blazor: Are components in the right folders? Is DI used properly?
variables.PERF_REVIEW_RULES:
- No obvious N+1 queries
   - Proper use of async/await in Blazor
   - Lambda cold start considerations
variables.QUALITY_STEPS:
2. For .go files:
   - Run `gofmt -l` on each file to check formatting
   - Run `go vet ./...` in services/
   - Run `golangci-lint run ./...` in services/
   - Check hexagonal architecture: domain/ must not import adapters/
   For .cs and .razor files:
   - Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` in src/
   - Run `dotnet build --warnaserrors` in src/
variables.TEST_STEPS:
2. For backend (Go) changes:
   - Run `cd services && go test ./... -v -count=1`
   - Report coverage: `go test ./... -cover`
   - If test fails, read the failing test and the code under test, then suggest a fix
3. For frontend (Blazor) changes:
   - Run `cd src && dotnet test`
   - Report any failing tests with details
variables.SECURITY_DEP_STEPS:
- Backend: Run `cd services && govulncheck ./...`
   - Frontend: Run `cd src && dotnet list package --vulnerable`
variables.SECURITY_INFRA_STEPS:
- Check that Lambda functions have minimal IAM permissions in infra/
   - Verify no secrets in template.yaml or environment variables in plain text
variables.PERF_CHECK_STEPS:
1. For Go Lambda code (services/):
   - Check for unnecessary allocations: look for `append` in loops without pre-allocation
   - Verify Lambda handler functions are thin (< 30 lines)
   - Check that DynamoDB queries use proper key conditions (no full table scans)
   - Check for proper context.Context propagation (cold start optimization)
   - Look for init() functions doing heavy work (move to lazy initialization)

2. For Blazor code (src/):
   - Check for excessive re-renders: components should implement ShouldRender() where needed
   - Verify virtualization on large lists (use Virtualize component)
   - Check that large data fetches use pagination
   - Look for synchronous calls in OnInitializedAsync
   - Verify images use lazy loading
variables.ARCH_RULES:
## Backend — Arquitetura Hexagonal (services/)
- `domain/` tem ZERO dependencias externas — so standard library
- `application/` depende APENAS de `ports/` (interfaces), nunca de adapters concretos
- `adapters/inbound/` converte HTTP/evento em chamada de service
- `adapters/outbound/` implementa ports outbound (repository, gateway)
- Logica de negocio NUNCA em adapters ou handlers Lambda
- Lambda handlers devem ser finos: parse request -> chama service -> formata response

## Frontend — Blazor (src/)
- Componentes seguem SRP: um concern por arquivo .razor
- Paginas ficam em `Components/Pages/{Dominio}/`
- Componentes compartilhados em `Components/Shared/`
- Services sempre via DI, nunca instanciar HttpClient diretamente
- Frontend desacoplado: consome APIs, nao conhece infraestrutura

- Testes table-driven com mock dos ports outbound

## C# / Blazor

- Services injetados via DI (`@inject`)
- Format: `dotnet format` aplicado automaticamente
- Build sem warnings

variables.ARCHITECTURE_DETAIL:
## Backend (services/)

### Arquitetura Hexagonal
```
services/
  cmd/              — Entry points (Lambda main.go)
  internal/
    domain/         — Entities, value objects (ZERO deps externas)
    ports/
      inbound/      — Interfaces de servico
      outbound/     — Interfaces de repositorio/gateway
    application/    — Services que orquestram domain + ports
    adapters/
      inbound/      — Lambda handlers, HTTP
      outbound/     — DynamoDB, Keycloak, RabbitMQ, Stripe
  pkg/              — Utilities compartilhadas
  tests/            — Testes de integracao
```

### Regra de dependencia
```
adapters -> application -> ports <- domain
```

## Frontend (src/)
```
src/
  ECommerce.Blazor/         — Class library com componentes
    Components/Pages/       — Paginas por dominio
    Components/Shared/      — Componentes reutilizaveis
    Models/                 — DTOs e view models
    Services/               — HTTP clients e services (via DI)
  ECommerce.Maui/           — Host MAUI (mobile/desktop)
  ECommerce.Web/            — Host Web (browser)
  ECommerce.Blazor.Tests/   — Testes unitarios
```
variables.CONVENTIONS_DETAIL:
## Go (services/)

### Naming
- unexported: `camelCase`
- exported: `PascalCase`
- Interfaces: sufixo descritivo (`ProductRepository`, `OrderService`)
- Files: `snake_case.go`

### Error Handling
- Sempre wrap com contexto: `fmt.Errorf("operacao: %w", err)`
- Nunca ignore erros
- Erros de dominio sao tipos custom

### Testes
- Table-driven: `tests := []struct{ name string; ... }`
- Mock apenas ports outbound
- Cobertura 80%+ em domain e application

### Lint
- `golangci-lint run ./...` sem erros
- `gofmt` aplicado automaticamente via hook

## C# / Blazor (src/)

### Componentes
- SRP: um concern por `.razor`
- Usar `RenderFragment` para composicao
- Componentes compartilhados em `Components/Shared/`

### Services
- Sempre via DI (`@inject`)
- Nunca instanciar `HttpClient` diretamente
